data.sample_job_titles_positions: Engineers, Programmers, Application Developers, Designers, System Architect, Business Intelligence
data.primary_responsibilities: Write and test code for applications and software programs to function properly. Test applications and programs to ensure they produce expected results. Tech Skills: Programming Languages (Java, HTML)

data.sample_job_titles_positions: IT Consultant, CIO, Info Systems Manager, IT Director, IT/Project Manager, Social Media Manager, Information Security Officer, IT Service Manager
data.primary_responsibilities: Plan, coordinate, and direct computer-related activities in an organization. Help determine technology goals of an organization. Tech Skills: PMP Software (Microsoft Project, Jira)

data.sample_job_titles_positions: Database/Network/Systems/Information Security Administrator, Business Analyst/Network Administrator
data.primary_responsibilities: Gather and organize information/data about a problem to be solved or a procedure to be improved. Can develop solutions, alternative practices, recommend new systems, procedures, or organizational changes. Tech Skills: Data Visualization, Programming Languages (SQL, Python, R)

data.sample_job_titles_positions: Supply Chain Analyst, Operations Manager, Supply Chain Consultant
data.primary_responsibilities: Plan, oversee, and coordinate the operations of a company. Typical responsibilities include procurement (acquiring goods and services from external sources), managing relations, and improving a company’s use of resources. Tech Skills: Microsoft Excel, Data Visualization, Programming Languages (SQL)

data.sample_job_titles_positions: Business Intelligence/Systems/Information Security Analyst, Enterprise Information Analyst
data.primary_responsibilities: Bring together business and information technology (IT) by understanding computer systems and procedures in order to design solutions to help them operate more efficiently and effectively. Tech Skills: Cloud Platforms, Programming Languages (Java)

data.sample_job_titles_positions: Technical Support/Technical Sales/Infrastructure/Security Support and IT User Liaison
data.primary_responsibilities: Analyze, troubleshoot, and evaluate computer network problems. Provide assistance to people and organizations using computer software or equipment. Tech Skills: Operating Systems (Microsoft, Linux)

data.sample_job_titles_positions: Business Development Associate, Account Manager, Sales Consultant
data.primary_responsibilities: Focus on complex and technical products for businesses. Work directly with customers to meet customers' needs and product specifications, prepare contracts, and answer questions. Tech Skills: Customer Relationship Management Software (CRM)
